title: Influential person
text: At a leaving do, you've been asked to say a few words about the first manager who really believed in you. Describe them and what they taught you.

title: Influential person
text: A younger relative asks what your grandparents were like. Describe one whose outlook on life has stayed with you, with an example of something they always said.

title: Influential person
text: Your local football club is collecting memories of a long-serving volunteer coach. Describe a coach who made a difference to you as a child.

title: Influential person
text: When you first moved into your street, a neighbour helped you in a way you've never forgotten. Describe them and what they did, without naming them.

title: Influential person
text: A new starter asks how you got so good at your job. Describe the colleague who took you under their wing and the habits you picked up from them.

title: Influential person
text: A brief conversation with a stranger once changed a decision you were making. Describe that meeting and what you did afterwards.

title: Influential person
text: Your town is nominating people for a community award. Make the case for a shopkeeper, librarian or volunteer who quietly makes the place better.

title: Influential person
text: Describe an older brother, sister or cousin you idolised growing up, and explain how they shaped the interests or choices you made.

title: Influential person
text: As a child you spent so much time at a friend's house that their parents treated you like family. Describe them and what you learnt in that home.

title: Influential person
text: Your driving instructor stayed calm through every stall and missed gear. Describe them and what they taught you that went beyond driving.

title: Influential person
text: You still play an instrument, paint or perform because of one teacher. Describe them and explain how they built your confidence.

title: Influential person
text: There's a colleague who challenged almost every idea you had, and you're better at your job because of it. Describe them and explain how.

title: Influential person
text: Your company has an award for the most inspiring colleague of the year. Nominate someone you work with, describing what they do, without naming them.

title: Influential person
text: A writer you've never met has changed the way you think. Describe their influence on you, without naming them or giving away their plots.

title: Influential person
text: During a difficult time, a nurse or carer showed a kindness that you still think about. Describe them and what they did.

title: Influential person
text: Describe a team captain you played under who could lift everyone's spirits when you were losing.

title: Influential person
text: One lecturer or tutor made a subject you'd dreaded come alive. Describe them and what made their teaching different.

title: Influential person
text: An apprentice in your team taught you something you'd been doing wrong for years. Describe them and what you learnt.

title: Influential person
text: Someone taught you to cook, fix a bike or grow vegetables. Describe them and how they passed on their skills.

title: Influential person
text: A childhood friend's family introduced you to a completely new food or hobby. Describe them and what you discovered.

title: Influential person
text: You know someone who handles setbacks better than anyone. Describe them, with an example of how they reacted when things went badly wrong.

title: Influential person
text: You once worked with a chair who made every meeting finish early and productive. Describe them and what they did differently.

title: Influential person
text: You met a volunteer at a charity event whose energy was infectious. Describe them and how they inspired you to get involved.

title: Influential person
text: Somebody once persuaded you to take a risk you'd been avoiding for years. Describe them and what happened when you took the leap.

title: Influential person
text: You had a teacher who was strict but fair and whom you appreciate far more now. Describe them and explain why your view changed.

title: Influential person
text: Describe someone who taught you how to give honest feedback without upsetting people, and the approach they used.

title: Influential person
text: During a hard year, one friend kept you laughing. Describe them and explain why their humour mattered so much.

title: Influential person
text: Someone at the very top of your hobby or field has influenced how you approach it. Describe their approach and why you admire it, without naming them.

title: Influential person
text: A parent or guardian once gave you a piece of advice you still follow. Describe them and the moment they said it.

title: Influential person
text: A mentor helped you decide on your career. Describe them and the conversation that changed your direction.

title: Influential person
text: You have a friend who always tells you the truth, even when it stings. Describe them and a time their honesty helped you.

title: Influential person
text: Someone taught you to love the outdoors, whether walking, camping or swimming in the sea. Describe them and a day out you shared.

title: Influential person
text: An older person you met had lived through a very different era and changed how you see the present. Describe them and what they told you.

title: Influential person
text: You watched a manager handle a real crisis brilliantly. Describe them, what they did and what you learnt from it.

title: Influential person
text: Someone's style or manner rubbed off on you, perhaps in the way you dress, speak or carry yourself. Describe them and what you picked up.

title: Influential person
text: A coach or teacher saw potential in you before you saw it yourself. Describe them and the moment you proved them right.

title: Influential person
text: You have a friend who can get any group of strangers chatting. Describe them and what you've learnt from watching them.

title: Influential person
text: One colleague always seems calm and organised, however busy things get. Describe them and how you think they do it.

title: Influential person
text: Someone once changed your mind about something important without ever preaching. Describe them and how they did it.

title: Review
text: A friend messages you, stuck for something to watch tonight. Recommend a film you love without giving away the plot, and explain who would enjoy it.

title: Review
text: Your book club is choosing next month's read and it's your turn to pitch. Make the case for a novel you love without revealing any twists.

title: Review
text: It's been a grim week and your flatmate needs cheering up. Recommend a comedy that never fails to make you laugh, without spoiling the best jokes.

title: Review
text: A colleague says crime novels are all the same. Describe one that kept you guessing until the last page, and explain why, without giving anything away.

title: Review
text: Your sixth-form nephew needs a documentary for a school project. Recommend one that changed how you think about something.

title: Review
text: A parent at the school gate asks for a book to read with their seven-year-old at bedtime. Recommend one you love and explain why.

title: Review
text: Your partner groans at the idea of another costume drama. Recommend a period drama box set that might change their mind.

title: Review
text: There's a sitcom you've watched a dozen times and still laugh at. Explain to a friend from abroad why its humour holds up.

title: Review
text: You've just seen a play in the West End. Describe it to a colleague and say whether it's worth the ticket price, without spoilers.

title: Review
text: A friend moving to a new part of Britain wants a novel set there. Recommend one that captures the feel of a place, without giving away the story.

title: Review
text: Your teenage niece claims anything made before she was born is boring. Recommend a classic film to change her mind.

title: Review
text: You're asked for a memoir to give as a leaving present. Recommend one that inspired you, without naming the person it's about.

title: Review
text: A friend setting up their first kitchen asks which cookbook to buy. Recommend the one you use most and explain why it earns its place.

title: Review
text: A friend insists they only read non-fiction. Recommend a novel that would win them over, and explain what it does that facts can't.

title: Review
text: Your brother never watches horror, westerns or musicals. Pick the genre he avoids and recommend one film in it that could convert him.

title: Review
text: A friend asks about a film that made you cry. Describe it, without giving away what happens, and explain why it moved you so much.

title: Review
text: You're on a long train journey with a friend who forgot their book. Persuade them to borrow the one you've just finished, without spoilers.

title: Review
text: Your own children have just watched a film you loved when you were young. Explain to another parent why it still holds up.

title: Review
text: You binge-watched an entire television series in one weekend. Explain to a colleague what hooked you, without revealing the story.

title: Review
text: A busy friend says they have no time to read. Recommend a short-story collection they could manage on the commute.

title: Review
text: Your family are planning a film night with grandparents and young children. Recommend one film that everyone in the room would enjoy.

title: Review
text: Describe a thriller that had you sitting bolt upright on the sofa at midnight. Explain what makes it so tense, without spoilers.

title: Review
text: A friend thinks science fiction is just spaceships and lasers. Recommend a book in the genre that proves them wrong.

title: Review
text: A friend is packing for a beach holiday and wants a light, funny novel. Recommend one and explain why it's perfect for a sunlounger.

title: Review
text: There's a film you think critics completely overlooked. Make the case for it to a sceptical friend, without giving away the plot.

title: Review
text: You hated a book when you studied it for your GCSEs but love it now. Explain to a teenager why it means more to you as an adult.

title: Review
text: Your local radio station invites listeners to call in with their favourite film of all time. Make your case on air, without spoilers.

title: Review
text: A colleague thinks animated films are only for children. Recommend one that might change their mind.

title: Review
text: You've just finished a book that made you see a familiar job or place in a completely new light. Describe it to a friend in that line of work.

title: Review
text: Every December, your household watches the same Christmas film. Explain to a new partner why it's become a tradition, without spoilers.

title: Review
text: Your niece is going to her first panto. Describe one you saw as a child and why it stuck with you.

title: Review
text: A friend found history boring at school. Recommend a historical novel that might bring the past to life for them.

title: Review
text: Your friend is about to watch a film adaptation of a novel you love. Advise them whether to read the book first, without spoilers.

title: Review
text: Your partner fell asleep twenty minutes into a slow, quiet film you adore. Explain why it rewards patience.

title: Review
text: A friend thinks graphic novels are just comics for grown-ups. Recommend one that shows what the form can do.

title: Review
text: You don't usually enjoy musicals, but one completely won you over. Describe it to a friend who feels the same as you used to.

title: Review
text: A friend starting a new job asks for a book about work or habits. Recommend one that genuinely changed something you do.

title: Review
text: Recommend a film where the landscape or city is as memorable as the characters. Explain why, without giving the story away.

title: Review
text: A friend is daunted by the length of a long novel you love. Persuade them it's worth the commitment.

title: Review
text: A visiting friend wants to understand British humour. Recommend a comic novel that captures it and explain what makes it funny.

title: Review
text: Your friend has zero interest in sport. Recommend a sports film or book that's really about something bigger.

title: Review
text: Describe a children's film that the adults in your family secretly enjoy more than the children do.

title: Review
text: Your neighbourhood newsletter wants a short film review from a resident. Describe a recent film you loved and give it a score out of five.

title: Review
text: You're setting off on a five-hour drive with friends. Recommend an audiobook for the journey and explain why it works better heard than read.

title: Review
text: A friend asks which fictional character you'd most like to meet. Describe them and explain what makes them unforgettable, without spoilers.
